title: Baguio offers free rides amid traffic congestion during Asean break

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—The city government activated free transportation services and advised nine public schools to consider flexible learning arrangements as traffic congestion affects commuters amid the influx of visitors during the extended Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit break. The city activated Oplan Operation Libreng Sakay on Monday night, Nov. 16, using available vehicles from the city government, Baguio City Police Office (BCPO), Baguio Fire Station and Baguio Water District to assist residents having difficulty securing rides home.
